name: Workspace Window Icons
author: Gavin Nelson
description: A task strip for Hyprland scrolling layouts that shows every window in the focused workspace, including off-screen columns, in spatial order.

barWidget.description: Window icons in scrolling-layout order, including windows outside the visible viewport.

schema.label: Icon saturation (%)
schema.description: 0 is grayscale, 100 is the original icon, and 200 is fully boosted.

schema.label: Inactive icon opacity (%)
schema.description: Opacity of open windows that are not focused.

schema.label: Icon spacing
schema.description: Space between window icons in logical pixels.
